assets.name: design_paper
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production UI asset for Unity game. Reference is the approved mockup. Recreate ONLY the screen's underlying cream Japanese washi paper texture. Full bleed seamless-looking 16:9 landscape background, pale ivory cream, subtle irregular fibers and light traditional diagonal woven ornamental patterns as in the reference. Exact brightness and pattern density. Remove ALL ink drawings, ALL UI, lines, border, people, text and symbols. Paper only.
No invented objects, no watermark. Keep the approved flat printed Japanese ink illustration style; clean antialiased high resolution output. Opaque background; no transparency.
